description: This file contains serialization and copying logic for the Collection<T> type within the Orleans framework, including codecs and deep copiers.

classes.name: CollectionCodec<T>
classes.description: A serializer for Collection<T> that handles serialization and deserialization of collection instances.

classes.name: CollectionCopier<T>
classes.description: A deep copier for Collection<T> that creates deep copies of collection instances.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Collection<T> to a writer, including length and elements.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a Collection<T> from a reader, handling references and collection elements.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the collection's elements into the writer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes elements into an existing collection instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a Collection<T>.

methods.name: DeepCopy (overload)
methods.description: Copies elements from one collection to another.
